objective: Focused primary-source novelty challenge: seek prior fully endotactic explosive stochastic mass-action systems of source order 3, 4, or 5 and lower-order counterexamples/theorems, without inspecting the proposed order-5 candidate proof.
status: No verified prior fully endotactic source-order 3-5 explosive network or theorem excluding all such higher-dimensional systems was located in this bounded search. Xu arXiv:2409.05340v2 remains current and explicitly says the minimum order is open. This is not a novelty or priority clearance.

definitions.source_order: Maximum over reactions y->y' of ||y||_1, the sum of the reactant/source coefficients. Source-reported by Xu, Section 2, p. 3 / HTML lines 80-82.
definitions.full_endotacticity: Xu v2 Definition 4.4: u-endotactic for every u in R^d, not only positive u or a specified vector. This distinction is material for the directional near miss in Example 4.11.
definitions.claim_labels: Source-reported means stated/proved by the cited source and not independently certified here. Reconstructed means the order or directional/endotactic classification was calculated from the displayed network in this audit.

sources.title: On the Regulary of Reaction Systems
sources.current_record_check: Official arXiv record checked 2026-10-08; history lists v1 (2024-09-09) and v2 only, with v2 current.

locators.source_reported: Defines mass-action molecularity/order from source complex y by ||y||_1 and network order as the maximum.
Full endotactic means u-endotactic for every u in R^d; the property is of the unweighted reaction graph.

locators.location: Theorem 4.6 and proof, p. 9 / HTML lines 286-314
locators.source_reported: Every second-order endotactic mass-action system is regular/non-explosive; the theorem also states lower-endotactic, strongly-endotactic, and weakly-reversible subcases.
Cites an explosive strongly-endotactic system of order 10 and says the minimum explosive order for endotactic stochastic mass-action systems remains open.
The one-species network S1 <-> 2S1 -> 3S1 is not 1-endotactic and is regular iff kappa_2 <= kappa_-2. Reconstructed source order is 2; it is not a full-endotactic counterexample.

The displayed termolecular network 0 <-> S1, 2S1 -> 3S1, 3S2 -> 2S2 is strongly (1,1)-endotactic and explosive on its stated closed communicating classes. Reconstructed source order is 3. For u=e1, the active maximal source 2S1 has an outward reaction, so it is not full endotactic.

sources.title: Non-explosivity of stochastically modeled reaction networks that are complex balanced

locators.location: Introduction equation (4), p. 3; Example 3 and proof, pp. 8-9 / HTML lines 212-228 and following proof
locators.source_reported: The stochastic chain A <-> 2A <-> 3A <-> 4A -> 5A explodes almost surely; birth and death rates simplify to x^4 and x^2(x-1)^2, with the paper invoking transience of the embedded chain plus a stationary distribution.

sources.classification: Reconstructed source order 4. Not full endotactic: for u=+1, the maximal source 4A has outward reaction 4A->5A. This is an order-4 explosion near miss, not a candidate-class hit.

sources.title: Stochastic Reaction Networks Within Interacting Compartments with Content-Dependent Fragmentation
sources.version_history: v1 2025-11-13; v2 2026-03-07; v3 2026-04-30; v4 2026-06-10. The paper was published online in Bulletin of Mathematical Biology on 2026-06-08; the exact version checked is arXiv v4.

locators.source_reported: Defines source and product complexes and uses the stochastic mass-action convention lambda=kappa times the product of binomial coefficients.

locators.location: CRN (8), p. 9; Proposition 3.10 and proof, p. 10 / HTML lines 294-317
locators.source_reported: Reports the fixed mass-action CRN 2Y -[2]-> Y; Y -[1]-> Y+E; E+S -[1]-> E+2S; S -[1]-> S+Y as explosive. The proof uses g(e,s,y)=1/log(e+2)+1/log(s+2)+1/(y+1), obtains Ag<=-1 outside a finite set, and invokes Corollary A.5. The footnote states the explosivity question was open in the original preprint.

locators.location: Corollary A.5, Appendix A / HTML lines 742-752
locators.source_reported: States a sufficient explosive-chain criterion requiring a bounded positive V, LV<=-1 outside finite K, a point z in K in a closed irreducible component, and a reachable y with V(y)<inf_K V.
locators.audit_note: The Proposition 3.10 invocation appears not to meet the printed closed-irreducible-component premise: on the restricted s>=1 state space, e and s are nondecreasing and from every state an increase in e or s is reachable, so no closed irreducible component appears to exist. This is a source-proof concern; no claim that the network is nonexplosive is made.

locators.location: Example 3.11 and Proposition 3.12, pp. 11-13 / HTML lines 320-367 and following proof
locators.source_reported: Separately studies an order-3 underlying chemistry and content-dependent compartment fragmentation. This is not a fixed mass-action CRN explosion example for the target question.

sources.classification: Reconstructed source order is 2 (sources 2Y and E+S). Not full endotactic: with u=e_S, E+S is a maximal projected source and E+S->E+2S points outward. The source reports explosion, but the stated Corollary A.5 premise appears unmet as described above; therefore this is recorded as a source claim rather than independently verified non-endotactic order-2 explosive prior art. It does not conflict with Xu Theorem 4.6.

sources.title: Classification and threshold dynamics of stochastic reaction networks

locators.location: Assumptions H2-H5, pp. 4-5; Theorem 4.8, p. 12 / HTML lines 421-440
locators.source_reported: Under H2-H5 the paper proves non-explosion on each compatibility class for an endotactic mass-action system in one-dimensional stoichiometric subspace. Conditions include nonempty positive- and negative-direction reaction sets, positive integer gcd direction, and every species changes in some reaction. This does not exclude multidimensional order-3-5 examples.
